remarks: Discover the perfect blend of space, luxury, and location with this bright and airy corner-unit condo-the largest in the complex!  Boasting an open floor plan with elegant hardwood flooring throughout, this two-bedroom gem is bathed in natural light from windows on every side, offering picturesque views of Scalzi Park in both summer and winter.  The kitchen features sleek granite countertops and stylish tile flooring, adding a modern touch to the space. Plus, hardwood floors are unique to this level, enhancing the luxurious feel of the unit. Storage is never a concern, thanks to built-in cabinets in the bedrooms. The master suite is designed for comfort, with a ceiling fan ensuring a gentle breeze complemented by the refreshing cross ventilation, unique to this corner unit.  Convenient Parking is available with One assigned spot and ample street parking in front of the building. The HOA Perks  include Heat and Hot Water, Gas. This building is also a Pet-Friendly Community. Your furry friends are welcome! This condo truly stands out as an exceptional find. Don't miss the opportunity to make it your home!
